author: Epic Games
description:
Play Killing Floor 3 for FREE during the Free Weekend on July 23-27! https://epic.gm/kf3-freeweekend

Venture to the Nordic North Sea to explore a mire-infested oil rig and the horrors it has unleashed in Killing Floor 3 Season 4 – Operation: Shadow Hunter. Explore a new map and play the highly-anticipated Gunslinger perk, which includes an armory of dual-wielded pistols and high-tech gadgets for destroying zeds. The update also introduces the elusive Dr. Moorcroft as a new boss and adds a new fan-favorite difficulty level, giving players a challenge between ‘Hard’ and ‘Hell-on-Earth” currently in-game.
title: Killing Floor 3 | Operation: Shadow Hunter Trailer

description:
With the opening of the Hidden Mountain region, Where Winds Meet officially enters a Wuxia New Era. 

Experience massive upgrades to world design, combat, storytelling, and audiovisuals. The new Mohist Hill sect also makes its debut, revealing a brand-new jianghu hidden within a thousand-year-old mechanical city.   

Follow the trail into the mountains and begin your next chapter. https://epic.gm/where-winds-meet
title: Where Winds Meet | Hidden Mountain Expansion Release Date Trailer
